tasks.text: Adding Heatmaps (Clarity): Clarity: sign up free at clarity.microsoft.com, add a project for developerhridu.github.io, copy the project ID into clarityProjectId in content/config.json. Click counts: redeploy the worker, which still needs the Cloudflare account that owns the developerhridu subdomain — the account I logged into (mizanurrahmanhridu@gmail.com) isn't it.
